# SEPTIC ARTHRITIS (NATIVE JOINT)

For arthritis associated with a PROSTHETIC JOINT see
[Infections in bone or joint prostheses](pros-joint-bone-infect)
For arthritis associated with a BITE WOUND see
[Bite wounds](bite-wounds)
For arthritis associated with TICK EXPOSURE in an endemic area, consider
[Lyme disease](lyme-disease)


Aspirate the joint for gram stain and culture. Use culture results to guide
definitive therapy Rule out N. gonorrhea in sexually active patients
Duration of therapy:
Duration of therapy is based on pathogen and clinical response. Please consult
ID for further treatment recommendations


## _______________________________________________________________________________

References:
Mandell chapter: Infectious arthritis of native joints
Sanford keyword: Septic arthritis
Therapy:
Vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q 12 hours 
History of Pseudomonas and/or severe immunosuppression:
Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h  <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h 
If synovial fluid gram stain with Gram negative rods:
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q 24 h
